newsitem.title: GHANA: Bank and breweries boost Ghana bourse.
newsitem.headline: Bank and breweries boost Ghana bourse.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange share index rose on Wednesday with blue-chip Standard Chartered Bank leading the way.
The GSE all-share index rose 1.86 points to 362.48 points from 360.62 on Monday.
Standard Chartered rose 200 cedis to 5,000 cedis, with Kumasi Brewery Ltd up five at 710 and Accra Brewery Ltd up two at 600, among five other risers.
The index fell 1.71 points on Monday, pulled down by losses in blue chips Ghana Commercial Bank GCB.GH and Kumasi Brewery. Ghana Commercial Bank fell two on Wednesday to 628 cedis.
Fan Milk Ltd fell three to 395, making it the main loser.
A total of 65,390 shares changed hands. Bids outpaced offers by 3,831,220 to 555,590.
